summary: Chorus and flanger: up to eight modulated delay lines, one per track, each with a minimum delay and swing depth in milliseconds, its own feedback from -100 to +100 percent and wet level, and a stereo phase; the LFO runs in Hz or locked to the tempo. For thick choruses and jet flanges.
use_for: Chorus and flanger with up to eight delay lines for wide, thick or jet-like modulation.
quirks: Each track is its own modulated delay line (up to 8) with its own settings; write a track's columns to use it, an unwritten track keeps its defaults.
Feedback is (v - 64) / 64; the tracks' absolute feedbacks together are limited to 99.5 percent, so adding tracks with high feedback turns all of them down.
Feedback at either end is hot: +3.2 dBFS peak at -100 percent and +10.4 dBFS over 30 s at +100 percent in the profile.
An LFO Shape attribute (0 sine, 1 triangle, 2 and 3 saw, 4 default, 5 to 7 odd) is set on the machine, not in the pattern; it is not in the manifest.
+2.4 dB at its defaults on the profile's test signal.

parameters.name: Dry out
parameters.how: Sets the level of the untouched signal, from -24 dB to 0 dB; the lowest step switches it off.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to hear more of the delayed copies; at the bottom you hear only the effect.

parameters.name: Reset Phase
parameters.description: Sets every track's LFO to this point of its cycle, 0 to 360 degrees in 240 steps (255 = not written).
parameters.how: Writing a value sets every track's LFO to that point in its cycle, 0 to 360 degrees in 240 steps (255 means not written).
parameters.sound: Use it to start sweeps from the same place each time, for repeatable jet sweeps.

track_parameters.name: Minimum delay
track_parameters.how: Sets the shortest delay of this track's line, from 0.1 ms to 10 ms.
track_parameters.sound: Short values give a flanger's tight comb; longer ones move toward a chorus.

track_parameters.name: Modulation
track_parameters.how: Sets how far the LFO swings this line's delay, from 0.1 ms to 10 ms.
track_parameters.sound: More depth means a wider sweep and more pitch wobble; low values only thicken.

track_parameters.name: LFO rate
track_parameters.description: LFO rate [Hz]. 0.05–26.3 Hz exponential up to 239; 240–254 lock the LFO to the tempo instead: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 28, 32, 48, 64, 96 or 128 ticks a cycle, as its own text says
track_parameters.how: Sets the LFO speed: 0.05 Hz to 26 Hz exponential up to 239, then 240 to 254 lock it to the tempo at 1 to 128 ticks a cycle.
track_parameters.sound: Slow rates give a drifting swirl; locked values keep the sweep in time with the song.

track_parameters.name: Wet out
track_parameters.how: Sets this line's level in the output, from -24 dB to 0 dB; the lowest step mutes it.
track_parameters.sound: Use it to balance several lines against each other or to leave a line out.

track_parameters.name: Feedback
track_parameters.how: Feeds this line's output back into it, from -100 to +100 percent (64 is none); all tracks' feedbacks together are held under 99.5 percent.
track_parameters.sound: Positive feedback gives a ringing, metallic flange; negative gives a hollower tone; near the ends it rings hard and gets loud.

track_parameters.name: Phasing
track_parameters.how: Sets how far the right side's LFO trails the left's, from -180 to +180 degrees (64 is 0).
track_parameters.sound: At 0 both sides sweep together; larger values spread the movement across the speakers.
